## Release — backlog-campaign v0.30.1

### ✨ What's new in v0.30.1

#### Slash command

- Typing `/blackhole` in Claude Code now suggests the three everyday modes: `run`, `catchup` and `stop`. `status` stays the default when no argument is given, and every other mode works as before ([#1275](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1275)).
